paragraphs.text: Leticia Delgadillo Zamudio was designated in Designation TIJ-12-01 on 2012-01-09. Red del Horizonte Azul was linked to Designation TIJ-12-01 on 2012-01-09. Designation TIJ-12-01 occurred at Tijuana on 2012-01-09. Regional press reporting from Tijuana described the designation by Treasury officials of Delgadillo, identified in the press as a launderer for Red del Horizonte Azul operating under the nickname La Libélula, together with the seafood exporter Mariscos Cabo Norte, as parts of the network. The published accounts stated that the seafood firm had already been named in an earlier designation and that the new action extended it to Delgadillo's accounts.

Gonzalo Ferreira Luján led Red del Horizonte Azul from 2010-05-30 until 2014-11-20. One column described Ferreira as the head of the network since its formation and speculated that the designation reflected information from a former member. The column offered no source and the reporting office does not assess the speculation as reliable. A second item noted that the seafood firm continued to operate and that its workers had not been laid off.

This digest summarizes open press reporting and carries no classification beyond the public domain. The reporting office has not corroborated the press accounts through its own sources. The Tijuana press in this period reported designations promptly and accurately on names and dates, and the reporting office assesses the identification of Delgadillo as likely correct. The nickname attributed to Delgadillo appears in no other reporting held by the reporting office and may be the columnist's. The account is retained as the first open reporting on the network's laundering side.
